definition: The development of the awakening factors as a practical training framework.
notes: Use this collective framework record when the seven awakening factors are named as something to be developed. Keep bojjhanga aligned with 'awakening factors' and bhavana aligned with 'development'; do not flatten the compound into generic meditation-language.

example_phrases.pali: satta bojjhaṅge bhāvento satta bojjhaṅge bahulīkaronto
example_phrases.translation: developing the seven awakening factors and cultivating them
example_phrases.notes: The running-text form in SN 46.1. The record previously quoted the bare compound `bojjhaṅgabhāvanā` to this discourse, which contains no form of `bhāvanā` at all; the strict verifier returned `inconclusive` rather than `absent` because the discourse uses peyyāla. Repaired 2026-09-13 with the SN 46.1 packet.
